newsitem.title: USA: AAR Corp sets new shareholder rights plan.
newsitem.headline: AAR Corp sets new shareholder rights plan.

text.p: AAR Corp said Wednesday its board of directors replaced the existing stockholder rights plan with a new plan.
The original rights plan, first adopted in 1987 by the aerospace and aviation products company, was scheduled to expire later this year.

Under the new plan, rights holders would be entitled to purchase shares of the company's common stock having a market value of twice the right's exercise price if any person or group becomes the beneficial owner of 15 percent or more of AAR stock.
The company said the plan is designed to encourage a potential buyer to negotiate with the board prior to attempting a takeover, but is not designed to prevent a takeover.
